modalities.evidence: The PVT is a simple reaction-time task

output.population: Human; following SARS-CoV-2; ages 22–78; grouped by presence or absence of self-reported cognitive symptoms
output.summary: EEG recordings investigating neurophysiological correlates of Post-COVID-19, with a psychomotor vigilance reaction-time task. Participants are grouped by presence or absence of self-reported cognitive symptoms; fatigue assessed by questionnaire.
